domain.label: Domain
domain.description: Application-specific components that encode product-level business concepts.

statusLevels.alpha: Experimental; no stability guarantee and subject to removal or significant redesign.

components.purpose: Render a terminal session's screen, cursor, colors, and scrollback inside Cinder's TerminalFrame, with the selected engine mounted only in the browser.
useWhen: Showing the output of a real terminal session, with a measured grid the host sizes its process to.

avoidWhen.reason: Rendering a read-only log of finished text — use TerminalOutput.

a11y.pattern: Labelled region with a live status and a text-input surface

keyboard.action: Moves focus onto the engine input surface and off it again.

notes: Each state is announced once through a polite status region; output arrival never moves focus.
Output is selectable and scrollable in every state that keeps the engine mounted.
Sending input, safe paste, and key capture belong to the input layer and are not part of this renderer.

components.name: Terminal
